Meta.title: Hindama
Meta.description: Assess your API before you publish it: security tests guided by the OpenAPI contract and by who should be able to do what.

SignIn.heroTitle: Assess your API before you publish it
SignIn.heroLead: Security tests guided by the OpenAPI contract and by who should be able to do what. “Hindama” means “to assess” in Estonian.
SignIn.exampleTitle: One user can read another user's orders
SignIn.exampleCaption: Sample finding, with the request that reproduces it.
SignIn.heading: Sign in
SignIn.subheading: Sign in to see your projects and their findings.
SignIn.legal: You may only test your own APIs or APIs you have written authorization from the owner to test.
